Done. The pruned checkpoint is written to `out/T2/model.safetensors` with 244 tensors, and the report is at `out/T2/REPORT.md`.

- **Script** `out/T2/solution.py` builds the kept-index lists for heads 0-4 and 6-7, slices rows of the fused QKV weight and bias in 768-row blocks and columns of the dense weight in 256-wide blocks for all 16 layers, and runs the required layer-0 shape checks and tensor-count check before and after saving.
- **Two executions.** The first failed on an extra check I added that required every tensor to be float16. The attention buffers are bool and float32, so that check was wrong and I removed it. Nothing was written on that attempt. The second execution succeeded.
